author: JerryRigEverything
description: Sometimes smaller really is better - especially when it comes to efficiency. The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is now so powerful that it can run three 5k monitors all at the same time, and 2.3x faster gaming performance than the last generation. (head explode emoji) HUGE thanks to @snapdragon  for sending over this ASUS Zenbook A16 - Powered by the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme - so we can see what it looks like from the inside. #SponsoredbySnapdragon #SnapdragonXSeries
title: Good things come in little packages
